scope: Actual native NSApplication icon capture and registered file icon, normalized sRGB pixel comparison; isolated WebKit and Electron file/renderer tests. Local real app restarted normally after confirming no edit form; existing requirements remain visible. No system settings or notification permissions changed.
diagnostics: Initial TIFF-byte equality was inappropriate: AppKit converts the runtime icon to Display ICC. sRGB normalization confirms maximum RGB difference 2/255 and identical alpha.
Initial NSWorkspace icon probe used a relative path and returned a generic document icon; absolute app path returned the correct mosaic calendar icon.
